changelog: Track choices across autoplay and native players. In "Use Babelfin's choice when playing the next episode" mode, tracks that an app copies from the previous episode are replaced with Babelfin's choice, including tracks of the same language and kind. Apps that start playback without naming tracks, such as the Jellyfin Android app's built-in player, keep Babelfin's audio and subtitle choices instead of Jellyfin's default-flagged audio track or an equally ranked subtitle track. Jellyfin's "Set audio track based on previous item" and "Set subtitle track based on previous item" are turned off by default for people Babelfin chooses for, and their original values are restored when the switch, the person or the server is turned off, or when Babelfin is uninstalled. A track change made during playback is remembered once it has stayed selected for 10 seconds. The Android app is recognised as "Jellyfin for Android". Person and server settings are converted to a newer format on first start; download all settings before installing. Tested with Jellyfin 12.4 and the Jellyfin Android app on Google Pixel 11 Pro XL. Jellyfin Desktop 2.0.0 was also tested on Linux. Automated integration tests use Jellyfin Web on a disposable Jellyfin 12.2 test instance. Android TV, Swiftfin, Streamyfin and physical TVs have not been tested.
